symptoms.label: Bleeding from nose or mouth
symptoms.hint: Bleeding from the nose or mouth can be a sign of a very serious illness.

symptoms.label: Difficulty breathing
symptoms.hint: Breathing trouble can become life-threatening very quickly.

symptoms.label: Bloated belly
symptoms.hint: A bloated belly can get worse within hours.

symptoms.label: Animal cannot stand
symptoms.hint: An animal that cannot stand needs urgent help.

symptoms.label: Sudden death
symptoms.hint: Sudden death can be linked to a serious infection that spreads. Keep people and animals away.

symptoms.label: Snake bite
symptoms.hint: A snake bite is an emergency, even if the animal looks fine.

symptoms.label: Difficult delivery
symptoms.hint: A delivery that is not progressing can put the mother and her young one at risk.

symptoms.label: Mouth blisters with limping
symptoms.hint: Blisters in the mouth together with limping can spread to other animals. Keep this animal apart.

symptoms.label: Fever or very hot body
symptoms.hint: Fever is a sign that the body is fighting a problem.

symptoms.label: Not eating at all
symptoms.hint: An animal that stops eating completely should be checked by a vet.

symptoms.label: Dull or very weak
symptoms.hint: A dull or weak animal may be seriously unwell.

symptoms.label: Blood in dung
symptoms.hint: Blood in the dung should always be checked.

symptoms.label: Swollen, hot or painful udder
symptoms.hint: A swollen or painful udder can quickly harm milk production.

symptoms.label: Drooling a lot
symptoms.hint: Heavy drooling can point to a problem in the mouth or throat.

symptoms.label: Discharge from private parts
symptoms.hint: Unusual discharge can be a sign of a problem with the womb.

symptoms.label: Eating less than usual
symptoms.hint: Eating less than usual can be an early sign that something is wrong.

symptoms.label: Not chewing cud
symptoms.hint: A healthy animal usually chews cud when resting.

symptoms.label: Loose motions
symptoms.hint: Loose motions can make an animal weak from loss of water.

symptoms.label: Coughing
symptoms.hint: Coughing that continues should be watched closely.

symptoms.label: Runny nose
symptoms.hint: A runny nose should be watched, especially if it continues.

symptoms.label: Limping
symptoms.hint: Limping can come from a hoof, leg or joint problem.

symptoms.label: Less milk than usual
symptoms.hint: A drop in milk can come from feed, heat, stress or the udder.

symptoms.label: Watery or red eyes
symptoms.hint: Watery or red eyes should be watched.

symptoms.label: Lumps or wounds on skin
symptoms.hint: Lumps or wounds should be watched for swelling or spreading.

symptoms.label: Losing weight
symptoms.hint: Slow weight loss can have many causes.
